description: The window-composition defaults — the seat framing every seat wakes on plus the authored named layouts (see WorldViewDefaults). An empty layout list falls the composer through to the built-in seat ladder.

seatRig.description: The chase framing every seat's view resolves through (the non-editing default).

smoothRate.description: The presentation-only exponential response rate (per second) the resolved eye eases at; zero disables smoothing. Applies to whichever motion the rig carries.

seatControl.description: The structural constraints/reference for live seat camera input.

yawReference.description: What the camera yaw is relative to.

minPitch.description: The minimum live pitch offset in radians.

maxPitch.description: The maximum live pitch offset in radians.

layouts.description: Gets the authored named layouts. The absence-coalesce lives in the accessor for the same reason Response's does.

items.description: One named window composition — an ordered list of WorldViewSlots plus a transition envelope, selected for a given session shape by its SeatCount (0 = the catch-all for any joined-seat count). The data-side replacement for a compiled layout switch: an author can see it, change it, and add arrangements.

name.description: The layout's stable name (the view.override layout override handle; unique within the section).

seatCount.description: The joined-seat count this layout composes for, or 0 for the catch-all.

transitionSeconds.description: How long the ease into this composition takes when it becomes active.

transitionRenderScale.description: The render scale (0, 1] applied to every slot mid-transition (a soft dip that sharpens on settle), the compiled director's 0.5f now authored per layout.

slots.description: Gets the slots, in order. The absence-coalesce lives in the accessor for the same reason Response's does.

items.description: One slot of a WorldViewLayout — a normalized rect (origin top-left, Y down) plus what fills it. A slot whose Camera is null shows the seat that owns this slot (the next joined seat in slot order); a named camera renders that authored view into the rect.

camera.description: The authored camera name filling this slot, or null for the seat that owns it.
